name: What is the difference between a full bathroom remodel and a minor update?
description: A full remodel replaces major components and may alter layout/utilities, while a minor update focuses on cosmetic changes without structural work.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a full bathroom remodel and a minor update?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full bathroom remodel typically involves gutting and replacing most major components, often including changes to the layout, plumbing, and electrical systems. A minor update, in contrast, focuses on cosmetic changes like painting, replacing a vanity or toilet, or re-grouting tiles without altering the room's structure or utility lines. The primary tradeoff is the scope of change versus cost and disruption.
